summary: Under normal conditions, the fund will invest: (1) at least 40% (unless market conditions are not deemed favorable, in which case at least 30%) of its net assets in investments that are economically tied to, or located in, countries or regions other than the United States; and (2) in investments that are economically tied to, or located in, at least three different countries, including the United States.
